body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2026-08-12 (Q1FY27 concall transcript): "there's only a few months deferment in the capacity expansion. So we are going to be commissioning by the end of quarter 2." Metric: Second +75k t commissioning. Target: 450,000 MTPA. Deadline: 2026-09-30. Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: moved-goalpost. Evidence: By end-Q2 (30-Sep-26) the block was not commissioned. Oct-26 call: 'end of quarter 3 ... or latest, at the beginning part of quarter 4', with no acknowledgement of the missed date.
